counter.text: Planar Seal — counteract Counteract check vs DC 1: critical success (rank 7 vs 5). GM to apply: Test teleport is counteracted.

dispellingGlobe.text: Dispelling Globe — counteract Counteract check vs DC 1: critical success (rank 3 (-1) vs 4). GM to apply: Test incoming spell is counteracted: only the portion of the spell that would have entered the globe is prevented; targets or area outside it are affected normally.

truesight.text: Truesight — counteract Counteract check vs DC 1: critical success (rank 6 vs 1). The check succeeds against Test illusory disguise: you see through it (it doesn't end).
